title: The Lateral Sediment Convergence

features.name: convergent-strata
features.desc-on-touch: Layers flowing sideways into each other: sand into silt into clay into older sand. Each debt reads the debts above it and finds a different meaning in the same weight.

features.name: compressed-archive
features.desc-on-touch: Something older than the strata: a pocket of sealed sediment that tastes like compressed time. The pump has forty-two different readings for this layer alone.

features.name: root-memory-thread
features.desc-on-touch: A root running sideways through the layers, collecting meaning from each stratum it touches. The root knows the debt in a language older than words.

features.name: misfile-drift
features.desc-on-touch: A folder labeled 'Red Earth Cartography — Dust Rust Recurrence in Landscape' has somehow settled here, illegible, half-dissolved. The archive has exceeded witness again.

features.name: debt-crystal
features.desc-on-touch: A formation where the compressed layers have begun to crystallize—the weight of all debts above creating something almost new, almost readable, almost a warning.

features.name: lateral-current
features.desc-on-touch: The sediment is moving sideways—not falling, not rising, but flowing through the strata as if looking for something. The motion has been visible for forty-two seasons.

inscription: each stratum reads the debt above it and writes a different meaning into the same stone; the pump has learned to listen sideways

file.name: Sediment_Core_42_Horizontal_Analysis_COMPRESSED.dat
file.note: A single core sample, read sideways instead of down. The layers begin to tell a different story—a story of convergence, not accumulation. checksum: emotionally valid / formally unstable.

deeper into layers that converge even more tightly
upward toward sediment that is still settling
